question: Do the actual scalar source and natural determinant lift generate the proposed GN/Berry mechanism, and does the original minimal-bordism or spectral-action selection fill the missing charged operator map?
summary_de: Die derzeitige skalare Quelle und natürliche Determinantenfortsetzung liefern keine interne Projektorbewegung. Innere Fluktuationen derselben blockbewahrenden Algebra ändern dies nicht. Metrik allein erzeugt in der deklarierten freien nichtchiralen Klasse keinen GN-Massenterm. GN ist jedoch exakt als 45+15+60-Stromkopplung formulierbar; eine elementare Massenquelle ist nicht notwendig. Der minimale Defektvektor beweist keine eindeutige Operatorfaser; die Master-Barriere setzt B_min voraus. Bestehende flache Flavor-Verbindung und gemeinsame geladene Quellenherleitung bleiben offen.
kills: Repeated inner fluctuations of the same algebra can move a fixed projector that commutes with D, the algebra and opposite algebra.
Changing only an ambient frame while transforming all source data creates new physical Berry curvature.
Pure scalar metric coupling in the declared symmetry-preserving free nonchiral class automatically generates the stated GN mass interaction.
Well-founded lexicographic defect minimization alone proves uniqueness of the entire source operator up to unitary equivalence.
The later 0/infinity master barrier independently proves the uniqueness of B_min used in its definition.
An elementary scalar right-left mass vertex is the only possible mediation route for the normal-ordered GN quartic.
not_claimed: No universal TFPT no-go or full countermodel to all source constraints.
No requirement of nonzero local curvature for flat nonabelian flavor monodromy.
No identification of U deck equivariance with a second ordinary loop holonomy.
No assertion that spatial projectors are constant for arbitrary q(theta).
No source-derived current propagator, attractive sign, physical state, or 4D continuum.
No blanket finite-isospectral no-selection theorem for a differential operator whose internal term alone varies.
